a8169b64.text:
<A crude rendition of the landscape, with a clear point of interest indicated.>

Mogodun- z kost a-hine
ta golg
gar thon- kha z'ta gor weard-hald

<The map is in too poor of condition to make out any other writing.>
a8169b64.title: Bloody Map

f0ffb8ef.text:
It is encouraging to hear that the new magic that our lord provided has performed above expectations. If the venom is as effective as you claim, it will be a powerful tool for us to use in the conflict to come. I told you that there was much to be learned from the undead littering our mountain. Don't worry, I won't hold your initial skepticism against you.

Finish your business there and return to the summit with your samples. No need to cull the beasts. If they spread to neighboring areas, they will only sow chaos, confusion and fear. This will serve to further the Pact's goals, in the end.

Good work. The Wild King will surely be pleased with what you have accomplished.
f0ffb8ef.title: Bloody Parchment

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12198|179c03d1.name: Martin Lindsey
12198|179c03d1.text: You think you have what it takes to destroy The League of Arathor, $c?  I hope so.  What is it that you want, or are you simply here to waste my time?

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

12961|c2467ddc.name: Kil'Hiwana
12961|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

246344|942bf955.name: Alodan the Hopeful
246344|942bf955.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

262558|165bbe08.name: Palah Thunderhoof
262558|165bbe08.text: What has brought you to the Earthen Ring?

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2798|a28d29e1.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3030|1605f087.name: Siln Skychaser
3030|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3032|1605f087.name: Beram Skychaser
3032|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3314|8fd1ef50.name: Urtharo
3314|8fd1ef50.text: So many years of battle and slavery, it feels good to have a home again.

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4631|66df9383.name: Wharfmaster Lozgil
4631|66df9383.text:
So you're here for the Warsong axes. Well, it's about time, $N. That crate has been sitting out there for days, now.

Feel free to haul it away whenever you are ready.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

9559|c670fd35.name: Grizzlowe
9559|c670fd35.text: I must say, Booty Bay has the best Clam Chowder to be had anywhere in the South Seas. Oh, not interested in cuisine eh? Well then let me be the first to welcome you to the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, the finest passenger ship to travel between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She's due back for another trip to Ratchet in the Barrens soon, so make yourself comfortable till she arrives.

1095-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1095-accept.text:
The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.

Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
1095-accept.title: Further Instructions

1102-accept.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-accept.text:
Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.

But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.

A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.

Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, $N.
1102-accept.title: A Vengeful Fate

1145-accept.name: Korran
1145-accept.text:
Many travelers who've come through the Crossroads helped me gather eggs from the Field of Giants, and many of them have tales of how deadly the creatures are. I've heard enough to consider them insects a much larger threat than my masters first thought.

I need a courier to travel to Orgrimmar to meet Belgrom Rockmaul. It be no simple matter, and someone who would take the task seriously should go.

Belgrom usually be found outside the warriors' guild house.
1145-accept.title: The Swarm Grows

1145-complete.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1145-complete.text: Ah, a note from Korran. He has been a loyal servant for some time now. I was wondering how his duties were going in the Crossroads.
1145-complete.title: The Swarm Grows

1145-progress.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1145-progress.text:
I envy you, $c. You have the look of someone who's been outside the walls of Orgrimmar for a while.

I myself would travel in the name of the Warchief if Thrall didn't have need of my skills here in the city. But he leads us well, and I trust his judgement--I remain here for as long as he needs me.
1145-progress.title: The Swarm Grows

1146-accept.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1146-accept.text:
So, Korran has come to a similar conclusion about these insects--they seem to be a larger threat than we assumed.

A few days ago a hunter returned to me from Thousand Needles nearly dead. He was with a raiding party sent to drive a dwarven excavation team out of the Shimmering Flats. During the attack, more of these insects erupted from a cave in the dig site and nearly killed the party.

They were led by Moktar Krin, and they've taken refuge on the border of the Shimmering Flats. Bring him this note.
1146-accept.title: The Swarm Grows

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

1195-complete.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-complete.text: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
1195-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1196-accept.text:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
1196-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

24-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-complete.text:
A victory for $N in the Ashenvale Hunt!  Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.

Shadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here.  Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger.  Thanks to you, this danger has abated.
24-complete.title: Shadumbra's Head

24-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
24-progress.title: Shadumbra's Head

25-complete.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-complete.text:
Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens.  From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends.  Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...

Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it.  Take this - you've earned it.
25-complete.title: Stonetalon Standstill

2841-accept.name: Nogg
2841-accept.text:
Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, $N!

Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, $N. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!
2841-accept.title: Rig Wars

3924-complete.name: Rilli Greasygob
3924-complete.text:
You got the manual!  I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange!  I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet--he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.

I want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...
3924-complete.title: Samophlange Manual

6442-accept.name: Marukai
6442-accept.text:
There is evil lurking here along the coast, $r.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.

Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
6442-accept.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6543-complete.name: Kadrak
6543-complete.text: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.
6543-complete.title: The Warsong Reports

6543-progress.name: Kadrak
6543-progress.text: Hurry, $N. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
6543-progress.title: The Warsong Reports

6545-complete.name: Warsong Runner
6545-complete.text: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
6545-complete.title: Warsong Runner Update

6545-progress.name: Warsong Runner
6545-progress.text:
So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.

You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, $N. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.

But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
6545-progress.title: Warsong Runner Update

6563-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-complete.text:
Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...

I can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
6563-complete.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6571-complete.name: Locke Okarr
6571-complete.text:
Excellent, $N. You've saved me a lot of work!

But don't think that I'm not grateful!
6571-complete.title: Warsong Supplies

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-complete.name: Pixel
6581-complete.text: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.
6581-complete.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

91904-progress.name: Dokimi
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

96136-accept.name: Alaana Stormwalker
96136-accept.text:
As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, $N?
96136-accept.title: Call of Air

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel
